## Functions

### `getComputeContract(name)`

Read immutable canonical metadata. Schema version is independent of ABI/operation/storage versions.

### `validateComputeContract(name, value)`

Validate a JSON metadata projection using only bundled, local references.

### `assertComputeContract(name, value, { code = 'COMPUTE_INVALID_INPUT' } = {})`

Preserve the caller's input; failures use the compute boundary's stable error category.

### `projectComputeContractValue(value, { maxNodes = 100000, maxDepth = 64, maxBytes = 8 * 1024 * 1024 } = {})`

Produce bounded validation metadata, never a transport encoding or binary copy. Accessors/unsupported host objects/cycles are rejected. Native byte lengths and element types come from intrinsics; caller properties cannot spoof native identity.
